instrument: Lakes of Marshall Ridge HOA and City of Keller v. Town of Westlake (Tarrant County)
summary: Suit alleges Westlake violated its zoning ordinance and concealed the project's purpose, including a site plan omitting the required 150-foot setback and landscaped buffer from single-family homes. On Sept 25 the judge dissolved the temporary restraining order and set a hearing for Oct 23.
notes: Plaintiffs allege a Dec 2024 P&Z notice for a 45-to-80-foot height amendment did not mention data centers.

next.event: Westlake data center hearing, Tarrant County
